marta (finance): early alert — NetSuite nightly rejected ~15 invoices with "Line amount must be >= 0". Looks tied to the recent pricing experiment (step discount + overflow credit).

josh (eng-billing): can you attach an example invoice id/payload?

marta (finance): invoice_2027_01_08_42 (sanitized payload below). NetSuite retried and then created a credit memo that doesn't reconcile to Stripe.

marta (finance): payload (sanitized):
{
  "id": "invoice_2027_01_08_42",
  "customer": "cus_DELTA",
  "lines": [
    {"desc": "usage", "qty": 1101, "unit_price": 0.05, "amount": 55.05},
    {"desc": "step_discount", "amount": -8.2575},
    {"desc": "overflow_promo", "amount": -46.79249999999999}
  ],
  "total": 0.0
}

josh (eng-billing): yeah that last line is a floating point artifact. After per-line two-decimal rounding the combination can create a -0.01 final line. NetSuite refuses negative lines.

anika (revops): AR already flagged variance for a few accounts. Can we pause automated memos/notifications until we confirm scope? CS needs a list of affected invoices for messaging.

leo (eng-platform): quick mitigation plan: 1) add sync-side normalization that formats numbers to fixed-2 strings, 2) clamp any line where -0.05 < amount < 0 to 0.00 and tag invoice metadata "normalized_by=sync", 3) run a 72h backfill to detect affected invoices. Pushing patch to staging now.

josh (eng-billing): also adding producer-side change: always emit decimal strings with 2 decimals and a "rounded_by=producer" field. Will add unit tests for tier+overflow combos.

billing-bot: deploy started: sync-clamp-rounding v1.0 -> staging (sha: f0a1b2c)

leo (eng-platform): replayed yesterday's failing set in staging — normalized lines no longer cause rejects. Scheduling a 5% canary in prod for 2h, then full rollout if AR metrics look good.

anika (revops): please output CSV of affected invoice ids to the CS ticket. I'll draft the customer template explaining phantom memos and that we will reconcile.

marta (finance): finance ops will need the NS ids for manual journal cleanup for two customers already adjusted.

josh (eng-billing): noted. I'll attach raw webhook payloads and the reconciliation CSV. Also adding telemetry so we can trace whether normalization happened at producer vs sync.

leo (eng-platform): staging -> canary start in 30m. Will post canary results and AR delta here. :eyes:

billing-bot: deploy succeeded: sync-clamp-rounding v1.0 -> staging (sha: f0a1b2c)

leo (eng-platform): canary running at 5%. Initial checks show no new rejects. Holding for full rollout after 2h.

anika (revops): CS notified, template ready, awaiting CSV.

marta (finance): follow-ups: 1) backfill last 72h and generate reconciliation report; 2) finance ops to fix journal entries; 3) consider blocking negative-line emissions permanently. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
